# Security verdict: #267, round 1

Head: eb5392555c017177d984844d558c89d15e5c83ad
Result: pass-with-notes. No introduced security vulnerabilities found.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No introduced vulnerabilities found | - |

The session exemption at crates/daemon/src/registration.rs:757-763 only bypasses the new child-registration brake. It does not authorize registration or skip the existing native-host and roster checks (registration.rs:802,1895). Removing the brake permits the same or more registrations; narrowing its scope for a continuing conversation does not turn it into an authorization policy.

Known limit: a deliberate same-user child can claim its holder's harness_session. This is not per-seat authentication, and is not new authority introduced by this PR: matching-session registration and pane-derived caller reachability already existed. C33 sets the trust boundary at the user account; C32 judges the introduced delta. Neither the session string nor this brake should be represented as protection against a malicious same-user process.

The Claude entrypoint check (harness/scripts/claude-session-start-pij.sh:24-28) uses quoted expansion and a fixed-format logger (line 12); the entrypoint remains data, not shell code. The OMP/Claude mode changes introduce no identified shell-evaluation sink. Added documentation contains no identified credentials, private repository identities/content, or unrelated machine paths under C21.

Cost: no new periodic poll, timer, or daemon process-launch site. The bounded registration ancestry walk (registration.rs:788-799) performs at most 64 in-process parent reads per relevant same-pane roster row per registration. The Claude skip branch calls the existing logger, including one date invocation per skipped start. No live before/after cost measurements were made.

Evidence: local HEAD matched the requested full SHA and the worktree was clean. `just pr-freeze 267` returned FINAL. The live GitHub check rollup for that SHA showed SUCCESS for check (22), check (24), rust-lint, rust-test (run 44491161665), and delivers (run 44491161814). Inspected F197 child/new-ID/inherited-ID/sibling assertions (registration.rs:2921 onward), F213 realistic restart-tree fixtures (registration.rs:3572 onward), and OMP/Claude mode tests. No local builds, tests, mutations, live exploit probes, or dependency installs were run; CI is the execution evidence. The packet's mutation results were not independently reproduced.

Authority: government-root resolved successfully; community/RULINGS.md C21 line 25 and C32/C33/C34 lines 36-38 informed scope.

Harness feedback: captured SUGG-001. A read-only review-readiness command combining pr-freeze and head-bound CI job receipts would avoid the conflict between review seats' no-build rule and build-backed boot/checks. This is process feedback, not a blocking security finding.
